description: This source file contains the implementation of the ToonGame activity for an Android application demonstrating cartoon animation techniques. It manages UI interactions, button animations, and activity transitions within a sample animation app.

classes.name: ToonGame
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating animated interactions and transitions in an Android cartoon animation sample.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures touch listeners for the start button.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resets view properties and sets up pre-draw listener for entrance animation.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes callbacks from the start button when activity is paused.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Animates the container to scale up and fade out, then launches the PlayerSetupActivity.

methods.name: squishyBounce
methods.description: Performs a squishy bouncing animation on a view, involving translation and scaling.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Calculates the animation duration based on a scale factor.
